 THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED:12.03.2015 PASSED IN MVC NO.716/2013 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND CJM AND MACT,
MANDYA, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.
The claimants, being dissatisfied with the compensation of Rs.12,27,000/- awarded by the Tribunal, is in appeal.

2. It is not in dispute that as a result of the motor vehicle accident which occurred on 28.03.2013,
Siddaraju Bahaddur @ Siddaraju, a 35 year old died.
3. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the claimants that the exoneration of liability on the insurer was not correct.
It is also contended that the income assessed by the Tribunal was improper.

4. As far as the liability is concerned, the Tribunal has exonerated the liability of the insurer on the ground that the driver of the offending vehicle did not possess the valid and effective driving license.

It is well settled law that in case of breach of policy condition such as non- possessing of driving license, the insurer nevertheless would have to pay the compensation to the claimants and thereafter, recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

Accordingly, the finding of the Tribunal in this regard is set aside and it is held that the insurer had to pay the compensation to the claimant and thereafter to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

5. As far as quantum of compensation is concerned, the Tribunal, on assessment of the evidence adduced before it, has come to the conclusion that the driver of the offending vehicle was responsible for the accident which has resulted in the death of Siddaraju Bahaddur @ Siddaraju.

The Tribunal has thereafter proceeded to award the following sums as compensation:

2  No. in (Rs.)
 1. Loss of Dependency 11,52,000  2. Loss of Consortium 25,000  3. Loss of funeral expenses 25,000  4. Loss of estate 25,000  Total 12,27,000 6.

In order to arrive at the loss of dependency, the Tribunal has determined the monthly income,
notionally at Rs.6,000/-.

As there is no credible evidence to ascertain the actual monthly income, it would be appropriate and prudent to adopt the monthly income determined by Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, which, for the accident of the year 2013, would be Rs.8,000/-.
7.

Since the deceased was aged 35 years, working as Manager at Satyagiri Poultry Farm and also doing agricultural work, 40% is required to be added to the monthly income towards future prospects, which would result in the income to be Rs.11,200/-.

Since there are three dependents, it would be appropriate to deduct 1/3rd towards personal expenses, then his monthly income would be Rs.7,467/-
8.

The income of the deceased for the purposes of determining the loss of dependency would thus be Rs.7,467/-.
9.
As the deceased was aged 35 years, a multiplier of '16' would have to be applied.
Consequently, the claimants would be entitled to a sum of Rs.14,33,664/- (Rs.7,467 x 12 x 16 ) towards "loss of dependency".

10. The claimants being the wife and the children of the deceased, they would each be entitled to a sum of Rs.44,000/- towards "loss of consortium" i.e., in all Rs.1,32,000/- and they would also be entitled to a sum of Rs.33,000/- under the "conventional heads".

11. Thus, the claimants, in modification of the impugned award, would be entitled to the following sums:

 1. Loss of Dependency 14,33,664
2 . Loss of Consortium 1,32,000

sentences.text: Thus, the claimant would be entitled for compensation of Rs.15,98,664/- as against Rs.12,27,000/- awarded by the Tribunal, along with interest from the date of petition till its realization.

13. The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation awarded within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment and thereafter to proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
14. The enhanced compensation shall carry interest at 6% per annum.
15. The claimants would not entitle for the compensation for the interest for the delayed period of 959 days in filing the appeal.
16. The disbursement of the compensation amount shall be in terms of the award of the Tribunal.
17. The appeal is accordingly allowed in part.
